annotations.text:
Deal Flow — warm paper, ink type, chroma reserved for deal status.
A date or flag is coloured only when it wants attention: at risk #96650f, delayed #a63c28, and #d6a13f for the same amber on an ink ground. On track is #2f6b4a on the card rail and muted everywhere else.
Type: Newsreader for mandate names, IBM Plex Sans for UI, IBM Plex Mono for every figure and date.
Stage filter on Pipeline is live; the other three screens are static. The book runs to 12 mandates, 8 of them written out. All deals, people and dates are fictional.

Two alternates for the Pipeline screen, kept beside the deliverable rather than instead of it.
A — Terminal: dark, all-mono, one row per mandate, 8 on screen without scrolling. Fastest to scan at a desk; harsher on a phone in a taxi.
B — Stage board: swipe one stage column at a time, generous cards. Reads the process as a process; costs you the cross-book view.
